title: Cider Braised Pork Potstickers
description: A twist on traditional potstickers, these pork and vegetable dumplings are braised in a sweet and tangy cider sauce.
instructions: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until tender.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the reduced apple cider and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the potstickers to the skillet and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the potstickers hot with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
